news.headline: Samuel started off his day with a bang, receiving a lateral from fellow wideout Mike Evans during a hook-and-ladder play
news.detail: Samuel started off his day with a bang, receiving a lateral from fellow wideout Mike Evans during a hook-and-ladder play by San Francisco in the first quarter, taking off down the sideline for an 80-yard score. Samuel failed to catch a pass and didn't garner a target for the first time in three game

profile: role: WR2 rotational — 14% of targets, 51% of snaps.
availability: not on the league injury report.
